mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, teacher_no, name, gender, title, college, phone, email, create_time, update_time FROM teacher

SELECT id, user_id, teacher_no, name, gender, title, college, phone, email, create_time, update_time FROM teacher
AND name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{name}, '%')
AND teacher_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{teacherNo}, '%')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO teacher (user_id, teacher_no, name, gender, title, college, phone, email, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{teacherNo}, #{name}, #{gender}, #{title}, #{college}, #{phone}, #{email}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
